decks.notes: This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects that deal damage to the opponent and generate value. By combining cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, it aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of damage and resources. Korvold, Fae-Cursed King serves as a key finisher that can grow in power quickly. The deck also includes removal and card draw spells to maintain board control and consistency. Overall, it aims to be aggressive and resilient against a variety of opponents.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro deck revolves around quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix for repeated attacks. The deck includes cards like Treasure Cruise, Ledger Shredder, and Pieces of the Puzzle to fuel this strategy. It also uses cards like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse for removal, while Galvanic Iteration and Temporal Trespass provide additional spellcasting opportunities. With a focus on speed and graveyard interaction, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with Arclight Phoenix and other aggressive creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly milling through your library to find and combo off with Colossification and Storm Herald, allowing you to enchant a creature with Colossification and then put it into play attacking with Storm Herald's ability. Other cards like Otherworldly Gaze, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Traverse the Ulvenwald help you find the pieces you need, while cards like Burning Anger and Izzet Charm provide additional support and removal. The mana base is designed to help you find the colors you need quickly to pull off the combo.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm opponents. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Grisly Salvage to find key pieces quickly, while also providing disruption with cards like Liliana of the Veil. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship, while setting up for a game-winning combo with Parhelion II and Greasefang. With a mix of creature threats and graveyard recursion, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace opponents to secure victory in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this Aggro - Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a rapid and aggressive assault of small, low-cost creatures. By utilizing cards like Luminarch Aspirant, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to quickly build a wide board presence and apply pressure early in the game. This strategy is supported by cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Brave the Elements to protect and enhance the weenie creatures, allowing them to push through for lethal damage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan using cards like Censor, Detention Sphere, and Supreme Verdict, while generating card advantage with Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also has a win condition in Shark Typhoon, creating threats while also providing card draw. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy, with utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The focus of this deck is to quickly swarm the battlefield with low-cost, efficient creatures and pump them up with anthem effects like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant. Brave the Elements can protect your creatures from removal spells, while Adeline, Resplendent Cathar provides additional token generation. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helps disrupt your opponents' plans, while Skyclave Apparition can take care of troublesome threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing the synergy between its creatures and combat tricks to secure victory.

Using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, this deck aims to cast big spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to overwhelm the opponent and win the game. It also includes cards like Thespian's Stage and Bala Ged Recovery to further support its combo strategy. The deck also includes a toolbox of cards like Fae of Wishes and Mastermind's Acquisition to search for specific answers or win conditions when needed. The goal is to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful combo while controlling the game with disruption and card advantage.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells, board wipes, and card advantage. The strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's plans, protecting key pieces, and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. With cards like Saw It Coming, Memory Deluge, and Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to slow down the game and grind out a win through attrition. By utilizing a combination of removal, counterspells, and card draw, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent in a battle of resource management and tempo.

The main concept of this Aggro - Arclight Phoenix deck is to quickly cast spells such as Fiery Impulse, Lightning Axe, and Opt to fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries, allowing Arclight Phoenix to be cast from the graveyard for additional damage. The deck also includes cards such as Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise to refill the hand and maintain pressure on the opponent. Chart a Course and Consider help with card selection and setting up the graveyard, while Ledger Shredder and Pieces of the Puzzle provide additional graveyard manipulation and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to disrupt and delay opponents while generating card advantage and establishing a strong board presence. It combines counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and protect key threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value through blinking permanents for extra value. The deck aims to outvalue opponents over the course of the game, utilizing a mix of tempo plays and powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants to secure victory.

This deck aims to aggressively play Arclight Phoenix by filling the graveyard with spells and then casting them to bring back the Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck includes card draw spells like Pieces of the Puzzle and Opt to help find key pieces, along with interaction spells like Lightning Axe and Spell Pierce to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining efficient spells with Phoenix and other threats like Thing in the Ice, the deck looks to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient removal spells and aggressive creatures to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. It includes a mix of hand disruption, removal, and powerful threats to apply pressure and control the board. The key strategy is to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of targeted removal and aggressive creatures to secure a swift victory.
